board.assembly: Factory male pins directly soldered in PTH; no female sockets

stack.acceptance_formula: Measured module gap - maximum local underside protrusion - opposing solder/tail height >= 1.0 mm at every overlap
stack.seating: Factory header plastic seated normally; do not assume its height. Reject/adjust assembly if measured clearance fails; no floating unspaced modules.
stack.ceiling_standoff_required: Measured tallest rear component/mated connector/wire bend height plus 5 mm; WIZ catalog18 mm datum is unspecified
assembly_order: All rear parts, including U4: solder from front, trim and inspect
Front U1-U3: insert, solder accessible rear rows, trim and inspect
stack.rear_first_scope: All 13 fitted back parts including WIZ must be installed before the 3 front controller modules; every front solder land must remain accessible
stack.status: Geometric prototype; D3 now lies under XIAO and requires its own local underside measurement; all Z dimensions and trimmed-tail fit require actual module measurement before assembly approval

rj45.service_corridor_basis: Engineering reservation for plug/boot/latch; verify actual cable and enclosure. Not a vendor dimension.
rj45.evidence: WIZnet dimension image:16.10mm jack width,20.32mm row spacing,6.40mm first-row offset,2.70mm jack projection. Official angled photo identifies opposite solder-contact side as rear.

mounting.hardware: Four nylon M2.5 standoffs, 5mm maximum body diameter; no metal near antenna ends
mounting.note: Check enclosure support and RJ45 insertion load; H3 lies between H2 and XIAO; H4 supports the right side of the jack; add an enclosure jack cradle/end-stop to bypass header-joint insertion load.

mechanics.service_envelope_basis: Engineering allowance: 5.5mm header housing width, 3.5mm beyond pin span total; No USB insertion/cable allowance. Physical shell extensions retained: Nano2mm, H2 1mm, XIAO3mm. Verify actual module shells and vertical harness exits.

rj45.service_corridor_basis: Engineering reservation for plug/boot/latch; verify actual cable and enclosure. Not a vendor dimension.
rj45.evidence: WIZnet dimension image:16.10mm jack width,20.32mm row spacing,6.40mm first-row offset,2.70mm jack projection. Official angled photo identifies opposite solder-contact side as rear.

limitations: Carrier assembled hardware untested; no fabrication authorization implied
Exact factory male pin fit and installed-board revision must be physically checked
USB cable shells and underside module components require clearance checks
RJ45 plug boot, latch, bend radius and enclosure wall clearance require a physical check; reserved service rectangle is an engineering allowance
Power headroom, thermal behavior and I/O backpower isolation require bench verification
External PoE splitter, 3.3V buck, WK2132 and peripheral harnesses are separate finished modules
Antenna keepouts are geometric engineering provisions, not RF certification
Generic module schematic terminals do not validate internal regulator or IC electrical behavior
New WK2132 firmware path and radio coexistence require integration validation
H2 R7 removal is required before assembly; exact purchased revision and open-circuit isolation must be verified
USB connectors remain physically present, but postassembly cable insertion is intentionally not supported
